name: breadboard-gbrain
description: Curated Breadboard-native knowledge skills adapted from GBrain concepts. All are general knowledge-work skills: read-only retrieval or proposal-only authoring. None enable coding, GBrain admin, direct writes, or capture. The full upstream GBrain skillpack is deliberately NOT installed.
$visibilityPolicy: Only three skills are user-visible in the Skills palette to avoid clutter: garden-research, capture-to-garden, knowledge-health. The rest are INTERNAL routing skills — still available to the authenticated Garden Chat and Terminal agents (they are general-knowledge, read-only or proposal-only), but hidden from the palette. No internal skill grants coding mode, GBrain admin, or writes.
